We are a world-leading manufacturer of high-quality polymer materials. With innovative products,
processes and methods, we improve quality of life and drive our vision to become fully circular.
Discover how Covestro's cutting-edge polymers drive progress in vital areas.

## Georg Brunstam, 1957-2023

On September 1, HEXPOL’s long-time CEO and President Georg Brunstam suddenly passed away. His
passing is first and foremost a tragedy for his immediate family, but is also a great loss for
HEXPOL as an organization and for the many who were touched by his commitment and leadership, both
on a professional and personal level.

Georg took over as CEO and President of the HEXPOL Group in 2008 after having held leading positions
in companies such as Nolato and the Trelleborg. During the years 2017 to 2020, he assumed the role
of chairman of the board for HEXPOL and then again led the company as CEO and President. Throughout
the years, Georg has created a strong organization within HEXPOL with many highly skilled and
qualified managers.

During George’s time with the company, HEXPOL’s turnover has grown from just below SEK 3 billion to
SEK 22 billion. Today, HEXPOL is a large and well-managed Group, a world leader in polymer compounds
with a globally established manufacturing footprint.

Georg was a highly valued leader and colleague who impressed with his commitment, visionary approach
and impressive business acumen. His strength lay in an unforced and straightforward leadership style
that made everyone feel seen – from the factory floor to the boardroom. Georg was encouraging and
generous with praise and always tried to highlight internal abilities in recruit

## Enriching lives through innovation

For over 50 years, and in approximately 25 countries, our 6,000 associates have been using science
and ingenuity to create innovations that play a critical role in the everyday lives of many millions
of people.

[About Huntsman][87]

## Markets

### Aerospace and Defense

Improving assembly productivity, reducing weight and extending the lifetime of parts are imperative
to reduce costs in the aerospace and defense sector. As a leading global supplier of
high-performance materials, Huntsman’s products help customers improve production processes, realize
complex designs, reduce weight, and remain compliant with stringent standards and
lower long-term maintenance costs.  

[View Market][88] [View All Markets][89]

### Automation, Robotics and Engineering

Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers and casting machines are used
across many industries to create components and technical parts for a range of applications. In
manufacturing, our materials improve the performance of parts in hydraulic, robotic and conveying
equipment, supporting the growth of smart factories and automation.  

[View Market][90] [View All Markets][91]

### Automotive and Transportation

Huntsman works with leading OEMs and their suppliers to develop effective solutions for the rapidly
changing demands in personal mobility. From the high-performance automobile to mass transit
transportation, Huntsman’s products and materials help the OEM to manufacture vehicles that are safe
and comfortable, with good aesthetics and reduced environmental impact through light-weighting and
improved fuel efficiency.

[View Market][92] [View All Markets][93]

### Building and Construction

Huntsman offers a range of innovative product solutions that improve the efficiency and
sustainability of building, construction and infrastructure projects across the world. Our
energy-saving thermal insulation, coatings and adhesives, composite wood products, thermoplastic
polyurethanes and foams help our customers develop applications for flooring, roofs, walls, facades,
doors, windows, driveways, roads and pipes.

[View Market][94] [View All Markets][95]

### Cold Chain

Huntsman’s MDI-based rigid polyurethane foam plays a critical role in reducing food waste and
extending the life of perishable goods. Our rigid foam provides outstanding thermal insulation
properties, leading to its widespread application throughout the supply chain of perishable goods.

[View Market][96] [View All Markets][97]

### Elastomers

Combining global reach with decades of experience in material innovation, we are experts in
polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane-based (TPU) elastomers and have in-depth knowledge of
their application across a vast range of industries. We have an extensive portfolio of hot and cold
cast elastomers, hot casting machines and TPU elastomers and develop solutions to meet specific
needs.

[View Market][98] [View All Markets][99]

### Electronics & Semiconductors

Huntsman’s innovative solutions are widely used in the electronics industry to protect devices
against chemical, mechanical and electrical loads. We offer a wide range of epoxy and polyurethane
encapsulant chemistries, and our broad industry experience and technical expertise allow us to
address the most stringent requirements for electronics applications.

[View Market][100] [View All Markets][101]

### Energy

The substantial improvement in global living standards in recent decades has created an
increasing demand for diverse, sustainable sources of energy. Used across major energy
sectors, Huntsman’s broad range of products help our customers meet this rising demand through
maximizing safety, production and efficiency, while reducing emissions and costs.

[View Market][102] [View All Markets][103]

### Footwear

Huntsman’s wide and varied range of polyurethane, thermoplastic polyurethane
(TPU) and textile-based solutions help footwear companies get to market faster.  To meet the high
demands and rapidly changing trends in the footwear market, we focus our innovation efforts on
sustainable solutions, automation, customization and smart manufacturing. 

[View Market][104] [View All Markets][105]

### Furniture and Bedding

Huntsman’s MDI and polyols are key ingredients in the production of flexible polyurethane foam, a
highly versatile cushioning material used in furniture, mattresses and pillows. Huntsman works in
close partnership with customers to ensure that consumer needs for comfort are constantly improved.
 Our sustainable textile solutions bring exceptional quality, safety, comfort and durability to home
and institutional textiles.

[View Market][106] [View All Markets][107]

### Industrial

Huntsman materials and solutions are used in several manufacturing industries to enhance the
effectiveness of the end-product. Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers
are used to produce conveyor belts and monolithic belts, cast elastomers, extruded parts and molded
parts.

[View Market][108] [View All Markets][109]

### Sports and Leisure

Huntsman provides a range of market-leading solutions that are used to enhance the comfort,
performance and attractiveness of sports and leisure wear, as well as providing lightweight, strong
and durable materials for sports equipment and athletic shoes.

[View Market][110] [View All Markets][111]

## Product Spotlight

### Huntsman's Battery Materials Portfolio Enables Transition to Electric Vehicles

Huntsman’s battery materials are critical to the reliable operation and long working life of
lithium-ion batteries. These materials also help increase cell capacity by enabling higher
conductivity, thicker cathodes, and higher silicon loading in anodes. The Huntsman battery materials
portfolio can enable emerging technologies such as high silicon anodes, solid state electrolytes,
flexible batteries, and safer aqueous production methods.

[Product Information][112]
[Watch Video][113]

Find the right Huntsman product for you

[Product Finder][114]

## Careers

### Make a difference with us

The ingenuity and commitment of our employees drive innovations across a wide array of markets and
applications, enriching the lives of millions of people across the world. Our people-centered
company offers incredible opportunities for those prepared to take responsibility for their future.

[View Careers][115]

## Sustainability

### Our commitment to sustainability

We see chemistry as a means of solving some of the most pressing societal challenges of our time.
Guided by our support of the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals and coupled with care for
our neighbors, we create products and innovations to help meet the world’s growing demands for food,
water, energy and opportunity. Learn about our journey to become a more sustainable business.

[View Sustainability][116]

## Investor Relations

Huntsman Corporation is a publicly traded global manufacturer and marketer of diversified chemical
products with 2025 revenues of approximately $6 billion from our continuing operations. Our chemical
products number in the thousands and are sold worldwide to manufacturers serving a broad and diverse
range of consumer and industrial end markets. We operate more than 55 manufacturing, R&D and
operations facilities in approximately 25 countries and employ approximately 6,000 associates within
our continuing operations. For more information about Huntsman, please visit the company's website
at [www.huntsman.com][117].

the previously announced all-stock merger of equals (the "Transaction") to form a combined company,
OlinHuntsman. 

[Learn More][78]

## Huntsman to Discuss Second Quarter 2026 Results on July 31, 2026

We will hold a conference call on Friday, July 31, 2026, at 10:00 a.m. ET to discuss our second
quarter 2026 financial results. Following opening remarks, the call will move into a question and
answer session.

[Learn More][79]

## Our 2025 Sustainability Report is Here

From innovation to impact- see how we’re advancing solutions that power more sustainable products.

[Read now ][80]

## SHOKLESS™ systems for electric vehicle (EV) batteries
## What’s inside matters…

Developed to encapsulate EV battery cells, our portfolio of polyurethane-based SHOKLESS™ systems are
lightweight, shock-resistant, thermally optimized and structurally strong – supporting OEMs and
battery manufacturers as they work to enhance the next generation of batteries powering EVs.

[Find out more][81]

## Are you looking for solutions to your challenges? Explore our digital portfolio!

Search for products faster by application, chemistry, or performance attributes—with just a few
clicks using our new product finder.

[Search Products][82]

## Our Technology Portal Fosters Innovation and Manufacturing Driven Collaborations

And we want to work with you! Partner with us to scale your innovation and unlock business
opportunities today.

[Learn More][83]

### Latest News

Jul 14, 2026

[OLIN and HUNTSMAN Announce S-4 Registration Statement in Connection with Planned Merger is
Effective][84]

[View All][85]
Jun 30, 2026

[Huntsman to Discuss Second Quarter 2026 Results on July 31, 2026][86]

## Enriching lives through innovation

For over 50 years, and in approximately 25 countries, our 6,000 associates have been using science
and ingenuity to create innovations that play a critical role in the everyday lives of many millions
of people.

[About Huntsman][87]

## Markets

### Aerospace and Defense

Improving assembly productivity, reducing weight and extending the lifetime of parts are imperative
to reduce costs in the aerospace and defense sector. As a leading global supplier of
high-performance materials, Huntsman’s products help customers improve production processes, realize
complex designs, reduce weight, and remain compliant with stringent standards and
lower long-term maintenance costs.  

[View Market][88] [View All Markets][89]

### Automation, Robotics and Engineering

Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers and casting machines are used
across many industries to create components and technical parts for a range of applications. In
manufacturing, our materials improve the performance of parts in hydraulic, robotic and conveying
equipment, supporting the growth of smart factories and automation.  

[View Market][90] [View All Markets][91]

### Automotive and Transportation

Huntsman works with leading OEMs and their suppliers to develop effective solutions for the rapidly
changing demands in personal mobility. From the high-performance automobile to mass transit
transportation, Huntsman’s products and materials help the OEM to manufacture vehicles that are safe
and comfortable, with good aesthetics and reduced environmental impact through light-weighting and
improved fuel efficiency.

[View Market][92] [View All Markets][93]

### Building and Construction

Huntsman offers a range of innovative product solutions that improve the efficiency and
sustainability of building, construction and infrastructure projects across the world. Our
energy-saving thermal insulation, coatings and adhesives, composite wood products, thermoplastic
polyurethanes and foams help our customers develop applications for flooring, roofs, walls, facades,
doors, windows, driveways, roads and pipes.

[View Market][94] [View All Markets][95]

### Cold Chain

Huntsman’s MDI-based rigid polyurethane foam plays a critical role in reducing food waste and
extending the life of perishable goods. Our rigid foam provides outstanding thermal insulation
properties, leading to its widespread application throughout the supply chain of perishable goods.

[View Market][96] [View All Markets][97]

### Elastomers

Combining global reach with decades of experience in material innovation, we are experts in
polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane-based (TPU) elastomers and have in-depth knowledge of
their application across a vast range of industries. We have an extensive portfolio of hot and cold
cast elastomers, hot casting machines and TPU elastomers and develop solutions to meet specific
needs.

[View Market][98] [View All Markets][99]

### Electronics & Semiconductors

Huntsman’s innovative solutions are widely used in the electronics industry to protect devices
against chemical, mechanical and electrical loads. We offer a wide range of epoxy and polyurethane
encapsulant chemistries, and our broad industry experience and technical expertise allow us to
address the most stringent requirements for electronics applications.

[View Market][100] [View All Markets][101]

### Energy

The substantial improvement in global living standards in recent decades has created an
increasing demand for diverse, sustainable sources of energy. Used across major energy
sectors, Huntsman’s broad range of products help our customers meet this rising demand through
maximizing safety, production and efficiency, while reducing emissions and costs.

[View Market][102] [View All Markets][103]

### Footwear

Huntsman’s wide and varied range of polyurethane, thermoplastic polyurethane
(TPU) and textile-based solutions help footwear companies get to market faster.  To meet the high
demands and rapidly changing trends in the footwear market, we focus our innovation efforts on
sustainable solutions, automation, customization and smart manufacturing. 

[View Market][104] [View All Markets][105]

### Furniture and Bedding

Huntsman’s MDI and polyols are key ingredients in the production of flexible polyurethane foam, a
highly versatile cushioning material used in furniture, mattresses and pillows. Huntsman works in
close partnership with customers to ensure that consumer needs for comfort are constantly improved.
 Our sustainable textile solutions bring exceptional quality, safety, comfort and durability to home
and institutional textiles.

[View Market][106] [View All Markets][107]

### Industrial

Huntsman materials and solutions are used in several manufacturing industries to enhance the
effectiveness of the end-product. Our polyurethane and thermoplastic polyurethane (TPU) elastomers
are used to produce conveyor belts and monolithic belts, cast elastomers, extruded parts and molded
parts.

[View Market][108] [View All Markets][109]

### Sports and Leisure

Huntsman provides a range of market-leading solutions that are used to enhance the comfort,
performance and attractiveness of sports and leisure wear, as well as providing lightweight, strong
and durable materials for sports equipment and athletic shoes.

[View Market][110] [View All Markets][111]

## Product Spotlight

### Huntsman's Battery Materials Portfolio Enables Transition to Electric Vehicles

Huntsman’s battery materials are critical to the reliable operation and long working life of
lithium-ion batteries. These materials also help increase cell capacity by enabling higher
conductivity, thicker cathodes, and higher silicon loading in anodes. The Huntsman battery materials
portfolio can enable emerging technologies such as high silicon anodes, solid state electrolytes,
flexible batteries, and safer aqueous production methods.

[Product Information][112]
[Watch Video][113]

Find the right Huntsman product for you

[Product Finder][114]

## Careers

### Make a difference with us

The ingenuity and commitment of our employees drive innovations across a wide array of markets and
applications, enriching the lives of millions of people across the world. Our people-centered
company offers incredible opportunities for those prepared to take responsibility for their future.

[View Careers][115]

## Sustainability

### Our commitment to sustainability

We see chemistry as a means of solving some of the most pressing societal challenges of our time.
Guided by our support of the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals and coupled with care for
our neighbors, we create products and innovations to help meet the world’s growing demands for food,
water, energy and opportunity. Learn about our journey to become a more sustainable business.

[View Sustainability][116]

## Investor Relations

Huntsman Corporation is a publicly traded global manufacturer and marketer of diversified chemical
products with 2025 revenues of approximately $6 billion from our continuing operations. Our chemical
products number in the thousands and are sold worldwide to manufacturers serving a broad and diverse
range of consumer and industrial end markets. We operate more than 55 manufacturing, R&D and
operations facilities in approximately 25 countries and employ approximately 6,000 associates within
our continuing operations. For more information about Huntsman, please visit the company's website
at [www.huntsman.com][117].

## 120-year Anniversary

From our founding to today, Trelleborg has been shaped by innovation, resilience and the people who
made it all possible.
[Join us in honoring the journey][28]
[Wind turbines representing renewable energy and sustainability]

## Sustainability leader in our industry

Trelleborg’s products and solutions have unique properties that protect the essential. We are
committed to contributing to a more sustainable development and society, which means taking
responsibility for our environmental and social impact throughout the value chain.  
[Sustainability][29]
[Employees collaborating in a meeting]

## Shaping Industry From the Inside

Trelleborg foster a culture where everyone can thrive and contribute, characterized by clear
leadership and accountability. We believe every employee has the potential to make a meaningful
impact and shape industry from the inside. 

[Meet us][30]

## Contact Us

Get the expert advice and answers you need within our global group network.
[Contact Trelleborg][31]
[Employees outside Trelleborg headquarters]

## FAQ
* What does Trelleborg specialize in?
  Trelleborg Group specialize in engineered polymer solutions. We offer a unique solutions portfolio
  for a wide range of applications, including the most complex. Early market insights and broad
  expertise make us a world leader in engineered polymer solutions.
* Which industries does Trelleborg serve?
  Trelleborg serve industries where performance, reliability and sustainability are critical; these
  include aerospace, automotive, medical, energy & renewables, water infrastructure, semiconductor
  manufacturing, food & beverage, and others.
  
  Our solutions protect the essential: people, industrial equipment, infrastructure and the
  environment.
  [Your Industry][32]
* What is Trelleborg’s strategic focus?
  Trelleborg focus on leading positions in selected segments. We make an overall assessment based on
  multiple parameters with highly selective approach, targeting attractive niches and developing
  globally leading positions.
  
* Where does Trelleborg operate?
  Trelleborg operate globally through state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities, R&D centers, sales
  offices, and distribution networks. We strive to maintain a strong physical presence close to our
  customers.
* What types of solutions does Trelleborg offer?
  Trelleborg engineers complete polymer-based solutions that enhance performance, efficiency and
  sustainability. Through innovation, application expertise and close customer partnerships, we
  strengthen performance and drive sustainable growth.
  [Our Solutions][33]

## Automation Technologies & Solutions

The rise of manufacturing automation is revolutionizing production lines. This wave of innovative
technologies and solutions promises to increase efficiency, improve quality, and empower
manufacturers to thrive in a competitive market.

Hot Welding
Sonic Welding

Sonic welding offers a fast, efficient, and reliable method for joining thermoplastics, making it a
valuable tool in industrial manufacturing alongside techniques like adhesive bonding and bolting.
While each method has its strengths, sonic welding excels in applications requiring fast cycle
times, clean welds, and strong bonds for non-critical structural components.

 

[Learn More][81]

Ultrasonic Welding

Ultrasonic welding uses high-frequency vibrations to create clean, permanent bonds between
compatible thermoplastics. This technology offers speed and precision, making it ideal for
high-volume production of non-critical parts where fast cycle times and strong, yet localized, welds
are essential.

Laser Welding

Laser welding offers a high-precision and clean joining solution for various materials, including
metals and some plastics. This automation technology uses a concentrated laser beam to melt and fuse
components, creating strong, narrow welds with minimal heat distortion. Due to its precision and
control, laser welding are ideal for applications that require intricate welds, join dissimilar
materials or have thin parts.

[Learn More][83]

Heat Staking

Heat staking is a cost-effective method for joining plastic components in manufacturing. It uses
localized heat to melt a designated area on one plastic component, allowing it to be pressed against
another part and form a secure bond upon cooling. This method is ideal for high-volume production,
particularly for attaching fasteners, clips or creating leak-proof seals in non-critical areas.

[Learn More][84]

Spin Welding

Spin welding is a versatile method for joining plastics with precision and strength. Spin welding is
fast and clean, using friction heat generated by spinning one part against a stationary one. This
creates a strong weld that is ideal for high-volume production of simple, leak-proof parts.

Ultrasonic welding uses high-frequency vibrations to create clean, permanent bonds between
compatible thermoplastics. This technology offers speed and precision, making it ideal for
high-volume production of non-critical parts where fast cycle times and strong, yet localized, welds
are essential.

control, laser welding are ideal for applications that require intricate welds, join dissimilar
materials or have thin parts.

localized heat to melt a designated area on one plastic component, allowing it to be pressed against
another part and form a secure bond upon cooling. This method is ideal for high-volume production,
particularly for attaching fasteners, clips or creating leak-proof seals in non-critical areas.

creates a strong weld that is ideal for high-volume production of simple, leak-proof parts.

# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

[See how we’re connecting care][52]

the infusion pumps that delivered her chemotherapy.

## Our Commitment to Healthcare Professionals and Patients

We are committed to supporting patients and healthcare professionals with innovations that are
driven by compassion for their journeys, a passion to improve care and the ambition to transform the
future of healthcare.

[A doctor in a hospital room looks off to the side]

## Products for Healthcare Professionals

### Primary Care [ Primary Care Go to Primary Care ][71]

Supporting every aspect of your clinical practice, including physical exam, diagnostic cardiology,
vitals monitoring and vision screening

[ Go to Primary Care ][72]

### Hospital Care [ Hospital Care Go to Hospital Care ][73]

Advancing products and technologies designed to speed patient recovery and streamline clinical
workflows

[ Go to Hospital Care ][74]

### Surgical Care [ Surgical Care Go to Surgical Care ][75]

Delivering innovations that enable reduced operating times, faster patient recovery and improved
outcomes

[ Go to Surgical Care ][76]

### Nutritional Care [ Nutritional Care Go to Nutritional Care ][77]

Personalizing nutritional care designed to improve patients’ health in the hospital, the ICU and at
home

[ Go to Nutritional Care ][78]

### Respiratory Care [ Respiratory Care Go to Respiratory Care ][79]

Helping your patients with respiratory therapies designed to simplify delivery and improve mobility

[ Go to Respiratory Care ][80]

### Our Products [ Our Products Go to Our Products ][81]

Enabling clinicians to treat patients more efficiently and effectively across care settings,
including in the office-based practice, inpatient care, outpatient care and at home

[ Go to Our Products ][82]
[Two ladies have a discussion in a coffee shop]

## For Patients

You are our passion. Your stories inspire us to work harder at bringing innovations that can make
your experience easier, speed recovery and enable the best possible quality of life.

[Discover Patient Stories][83]

### More For Patients

### General Healthcare [ General Healthcare Go to General Healthcare ][84]

Whether you are receiving care in the hospital, at your doctor’s office or at home, we are here to
support every step of your journey.

[ Go to General Healthcare ][85]

### Nutritional Care [ Nutritional Care Go to Nutritional Care ][86]

When medical conditions prevent you from adequately feeding yourself, we provide clinical nutrition
options to help you regain your nutritional status.

[ Go to Nutritional Care ][87]

### Respiratory Care [ Respiratory Care Go to Respiratory Care ][88]

We are committed to helping you with innovative products that deliver effective, proven respiratory
therapy in the hospital and at home.

[ Go to Respiratory Care ][89]

## Bringing our Purpose to Life

Our mission to save and sustain lives is reflected in our business priorities and our commitment to
be an agent of change at a global level. This means doing what is right for our planet, our patients
and customers, our teams and our communities. We put this commitment into action through high-impact
philanthropy, diversity, equity and inclusion, nurturing partnerships with the healthcare community
and striving for the highest standards of corporate responsibility.

### Our Leadership

Our forward-looking leadership team is a driving force in ensuring we meet our commitments – every
day and everywhere.

[Learn More About Our Leadership][90]

### Our Corporate Responsibility

For nearly a century, we have made a meaningful difference in global healthcare while creating
lasting value for the communities we serve.

[Learn More About Our Corporate Responsibility][91]

### Careers

This is where an inclusive community of diverse individuals is driven to go beyond what is, to what
is possible in healthcare.

[Learn More About Careers at Baxter][92]

### Our History

For more than 90 years, we’ve been focused on our commitment to save and sustain lives with
innovations that elevate patient care, improve outcomes and drive healthcare transformation.

[Learn More About Our History][93]

[card-medical-device-integration]

## Medical Device Integration

Unlock the value of your medical devices with a vendor neutral platform that enables secure capture
of virtually all live-streaming data – measurements, settings, alarms and waveforms – from over
1,200 different medical devices. Data can be delivered using industry standard protocols to over 100
different systems, including electronic health records (EHRs), clinical information systems,
decision support, alarm management, research and reporting.

### Explore our connectivity management solutions:
* [Philips Axon][88]
* [Capsule Neuron][89]
* [Capsule Vitals Stream][90]
* [Chart Xpress][91]

### Explore our data management solution:
* [Medical Device Information Platform][92]
* [Advanced Integration][93]

[ Request a demo ][94]
[card-virtual-care]

## Virtual Care

As health systems turn to virtual care models to address staffing shortages, eCareManager helps by
enabling inpatient care teams to seamlessly connect with remote clinicians. Timely insights,
customizable alerts and data-driven benchmarks with a goal of helping ensure the quality and
efficiency of patient care delivery.

### Explore our solutions:

[eCareManager][95]

[ Request a demo ][96]
[card-retrospective-analytics]

## Retrospective Analytics

Clinical Insights Manager is a service-oriented, end-to-end solution that allows hospitals to
synthesize high-fidelity clinical data. It combines storage and aggregation of data with tools that
allow you to query, filter and sort it so you can transform this information into valuable insights
that help you achieve your clinical healthcare goals.

### Explore our solution:

[Clinical Insights Manager][97]

[ Request a demo ][98]
[card-surveillance]

## Surveillance

Capsule Surveillance helps simplify complex workflows and makes patient monitoring insightful by
continuous analysis of live, streaming medical data. Clinical surveillance facilitates proactive
care by sending precise notifications to the healthcare team.

### Explore our solutions:

[Capsule Surveillance][99]

[ Request a demo ][100]
[card-clinical-information-system]

## Clinical Information System

Philips IntelliSpace Critical Care and Anesthesia (ICCA) is a clinical decision support and
documentation solution for the complex critical and perioperative care environments. ICCA
centralizes, streamlines and provides simplified visual data to deliver structured documentation and
support high-quality and efficient care delivery.

### Explore our solution:

[IntelliSpace Critical Care and Anethesia][101]

[ Request a demo ][102]

Our portfolio of informatics solutions—medical device integration, system integration engine, cloud
data storage and analytics, clinical surveillance, intensive care and perioperative patient data
management, and virtual care—provides not just individual products, but a suite of applications that
seamlessly integrate with each other and your existing hospital systems.

Unlock the value of your medical devices with a vendor neutral platform that enables secure capture
of virtually all live-streaming data – measurements, settings, alarms and waveforms – from over
1,200 different medical devices. Data can be delivered using industry standard protocols to over 100
different systems, including electronic health records (EHRs), clinical information systems,
decision support, alarm management, research and reporting.

# About Us

### CHT - Global Silicone Experts

CHT further strengthened its position as a global producer of speciality silicone elastomers and
rubber with the acquisition of the ICM silicones Group in 2017 which included Quantum Silicones, ACC
Silicones, ICM Products, Amber Silicones and Treco SRL. Now operating under the CHT brand, the
expanded group includes manufacturing plants and technical laboratories in Germany, Austria, United
Kingdom, Italy, North America and China.

Sales and technical support are provided through an international network of CHT offices and
partners located in over 60 countries around the world in all continents.
* silicone elastomers
* silicone fluids
* silicone emulsions
* silicone antifoams
* silicone adhesive sealants
* silicone coatings

### Technical Capabilities 

Building upon its vast experience and expertise as a speciality chemical
company, the CHT Group offers silicone materials using a diverse range of base chemistries. These
chemistries enable products to be formulated to meet the specific processing needs and physical
demands of very different industries. 

CHT has the capability to manufacture both 1-Part and 2-Part silicone compounds which will cure
at either room temperature (RTV) or by using heat. Crosslinking systems include condensation
cure, using tin and addition cure, using platinum. Within our range, we have recently developed
LSR’s (Liquid Silicone Rubber). These liquid silicone elastomers are specifically designed for the
use in fully automated industrial processes such as LIMS (Liquid Injection Moulding Systems). 

Additionally, we can support you with our highly specialised formulating additives and master
batches which will offer total flexibility when creating your own formulations. Our silicones can
also be supplied as aqueous liquids using our sophisticated emulsification technology. 

If you need assistance with your product selection, the CHT technical team
are available to share application-based advice. Developing bespoke products that meet all your
design and functional requirements, is also one part of our core business.

For further information about the CHT Group see our [Company Profile][125] page.

# About Us

### CHT - Global Silicone Experts

CHT further strengthened its position as a global producer of speciality silicone elastomers and
rubber with the acquisition of the ICM silicones Group in 2017 which included Quantum Silicones, ACC
Silicones, ICM Products, Amber Silicones and Treco SRL. Now operating under the CHT brand, the
expanded group includes manufacturing plants and technical laboratories in Germany, Austria, United
Kingdom, Italy, North America and China.

Sales and technical support are provided through an international network of CHT offices and
partners located in over 60 countries around the world in all continents.
* silicone elastomers
* silicone fluids
* silicone emulsions
* silicone antifoams
* silicone adhesive sealants
* silicone coatings

### Technical Capabilities 

Building upon its vast experience and expertise as a speciality chemical
company, the CHT Group offers silicone materials using a diverse range of base chemistries. These
chemistries enable products to be formulated to meet the specific processing needs and physical
demands of very different industries. 

CHT has the capability to manufacture both 1-Part and 2-Part silicone compounds which will cure
at either room temperature (RTV) or by using heat. Crosslinking systems include condensation
cure, using tin and addition cure, using platinum. Within our range, we have recently developed
LSR’s (Liquid Silicone Rubber). These liquid silicone elastomers are specifically designed for the
use in fully automated industrial processes such as LIMS (Liquid Injection Moulding Systems). 

Additionally, we can support you with our highly specialised formulating additives and master
batches which will offer total flexibility when creating your own formulations. Our silicones can
also be supplied as aqueous liquids using our sophisticated emulsification technology. 

If you need assistance with your product selection, the CHT technical team
are available to share application-based advice. Developing bespoke products that meet all your
design and functional requirements, is also one part of our core business.

For further information about the CHT Group see our [Company Profile][125] page.

# Welcome to Dräger in India

**Turning technology into “Technology for Life”**

Dräger manufactures medical and safety technology products. In so doing, we protect, support, and
save people's lives around the world in hospitals, with fire departments, emergency services,
authorities, and in mining as well as industry. Founded in Lübeck in 1889, Dräger has grown into a
worldwide, listed enterprise in its fifth generation as a family-run business. Dräger has more than
16,000 employees worldwide and is present in over 190 countries around the globe. In 2023, the
company generated net sales of around EUR 3.4 billion.

Dräger technology is used all over the world. We operate in around 50 countries with our own sales
and service companies directly on location where our customers are.

[male-doctor-3-2-D-30493-2017]

#### Hospital

Improving critical care is what drives us. Learn how our solutions can help you protect, support and
save lives – across departments and across your hospital.

[Learn more][84]
[Dräger puts safety first with protective equipment for all industrial purposes]

#### Safety

Dräger is a globally recognised name in the field of safety technology. No matter your industry, our
focus is to keep you safe on the job.

[Learn more][85]
[contact-us_safety-3-2]

#### Contact

Get in touch with Dräger. We are happy to help.

[Contact Us][86]

> “Everything we do, we do with passion – and we do it for life.”

Stefan Dräger, Executive Board Chairman

monitoring system that fits securely into your hospital’s network to give you all-time data access
and optimise your workflows.

[Learn more][87]

Our products are always designed with minimal parts and infection prevention in mind – helping you

As Your Specialist in Acute Care, we continue developing outstanding technology and delivering

# Welcome to Dräger in India

**Turning technology into “Technology for Life”**

Dräger manufactures medical and safety technology products. In so doing, we protect, support, and
save people's lives around the world in hospitals, with fire departments, emergency services,
authorities, and in mining as well as industry. Founded in Lübeck in 1889, Dräger has grown into a
worldwide, listed enterprise in its fifth generation as a family-run business. Dräger has more than
16,000 employees worldwide and is present in over 190 countries around the globe. In 2023, the
company generated net sales of around EUR 3.4 billion.

Dräger technology is used all over the world. We operate in around 50 countries with our own sales
and service companies directly on location where our customers are.

[male-doctor-3-2-D-30493-2017]

#### Hospital

Improving critical care is what drives us. Learn how our solutions can help you protect, support and
save lives – across departments and across your hospital.

[Learn more][84]
[Dräger puts safety first with protective equipment for all industrial purposes]

#### Safety

Dräger is a globally recognised name in the field of safety technology. No matter your industry, our
focus is to keep you safe on the job.

[Learn more][85]
[contact-us_safety-3-2]

#### Contact

Get in touch with Dräger. We are happy to help.

[Contact Us][86]

> “Everything we do, we do with passion – and we do it for life.”

Stefan Dräger, Executive Board Chairman

## News, highlights & events

—
[Vista-300-3-2-DMC-104650]

#### Introducing the new Vista 300 patient monitor

An essential patient monitor for adults, paediatrics, and neonates. It is part of a scalable patient
monitoring system that fits securely into your hospital’s network to give you all-time data access
and optimise your workflows.

[Learn more][87]
[caregivers-use-sterile-gear-to-help-prevent-infection-3-2-d-3511-2018]

#### Infection Prevention & Control in Hospitals

Our products are always designed with minimal parts and infection prevention in mind – helping you
to improve workflow efficiency and reduce the risk of such infections in your hospital.

[Learn more][88]
[NICU-Scene-3-2-D-6667-2018]

#### Continually evolving care for newborns

As Your Specialist in Acute Care, we continue developing outstanding technology and delivering
innovative design that is focused on your newborns.

[Learn more][89]
[xnode]

#### Dräger X-node

Dräger X-node is a wireless IoT solution for process monitoring and analysis. The system solution
converts reliable measurement data - gas concentration, temperature, humidity and pressure - from
the X-node device into valuable information that you can access, analyse, visualise, monitor and
store online via the X-node Hub.

[Learn more][90]
[X-plore-8300-carpentry-3-2]

#### Dräger X-plore 8300

Reliable respiratory protection against harmful particles with no noticeable breathing resistance or
restriction to movement: The Dräger X-plore 8300 is the smallest and lightest PAPR device in its
class, offering maximum protection and comfort.

[Learn more][91]
[Main-Suraksha-Parmo-Dharma-v2-3-2]

#### Suraksha Parmo Dharma

As trusted partners, we are dedicated to ensuring that no matter the complexity of the task, you
have Dräger's unwavering support. 

Suraksha Parmo Dharma, a Sanskrit maxim, it means safety is the highest duty. In an era where
workplace hazards, industrial accidents and emergency response risks persist.

[Learn more][92]
[IN-CSR-PCVC-3-2]

#### CSR Initiative Supported by Dräger Safety India

Dräger Safety India proudly announces its successful CSR initiative with PCVC, supporting survivors
of domestic and interpersonal violence, highlighting our commitment to protecting and saving lives.

[Learn more][93]

[patient centered care icon]

We don’t just care for your health conditions. We care about you. That means [our providers][65]
take the time to listen to what’s important to you before recommending next steps.

Cleveland Clinic is recognized in the U.S. and throughout the world for its expertise and care.

[skilled and collaborative providers icon]

### Collaborative providers:

You’ll get care from board-certified and fellowship trained experts who work together to create a
treatment plan just for you. Only the highest standards ensure [excellent outcomes][66].

[Innovation and Research Icon]

### Innovation and research:

We’re focused on today — and tomorrow. Our focus on [research][67] and offering the latest options
means you can find a wide range of [clinical trials][68] and other care that you can’t find
elsewhere.

Materials and technologies supporting diverse delivery platforms

## Drug Delivery Solutions

NOF AMERICA offers a broad portfolio of high-performance materials designed to support a wide range
of drug delivery systems, enabling formulation flexibility, reliability, and scalability across
therapeutic modalities.
[Learn More][51]

Ultra-Hydrophilic Polymers for Safer, Smarter Medical Devices

## Next-Generation Biocompatibility for Medical Innovation

Delivering advanced MPC-based polymers like Lipidure®, engineered to create ultra-hydrophilic,
protein-repellent surfaces that enhance safety and performance in medical devices, diagnostics, and
eye-care solutions.
[Learn more][52]

Advanced materials designed for stability, feel, and function.

## Precision materials for next-generation cosmetics.

From specialty polymers to functional actives, NOF AMERICA supports modern cosmetic formulation with
materials engineered for consistency, compatibility, and scalable production—helping R&D teams turn
concepts into reliable products.
[Learn more][53]

Functional materials engineered for complex systems.

## Advanced Chemistry. Proven Reliability.

With a focus on molecular control and material performance, NOF AMERICA delivers specialty chemicals
that enable precision processing, stable formulations, and scalable production in highly technical
environments.
[View Products][54]

## Categories
* ### Drug Delivery
  
  Boost drug stability, efficacy, and safety with next-gen PEGs and lipids.
  
  [View all products  ][55]
* ### Medical / Diagnostic
  
  MPC-based materials for biocompatibility, accuracy, and safety in life-science applications.
  
  [View all products  ][56]
* ### Cosmetics & Personal Care
  
  Functional ingredients engineered for stability, performance, and formulation control in
  cosmetics.
  
  [Learn more  ][57]
* ### Speciality Chemicals
  
  Grafted blends and elastomers for durable, high-performance materials.
  
  [Learn more  ][58]

## **NOF AMERICA CORPORATION**

NOF AMERICA CORPORATION delivers high-purity PEGs, lipids, and polymers that advance next-generation
drug delivery and biotechnology.

With expertise from NOF CORPORATION in Japan, we provide innovative materials that improve
stability, efficacy, and safety in pharmaceuticals and healthcare.

protein-repellent surfaces that enhance safety and performance in medical devices, diagnostics, and
eye-care solutions.
[Learn more][52]

Advanced materials designed for stability, feel, and function.

## Precision materials for next-generation cosmetics.

From specialty polymers to functional actives, NOF AMERICA supports modern cosmetic formulation with
materials engineered for consistency, compatibility, and scalable production—helping R&D teams turn
concepts into reliable products.
[Learn more][53]

Functional materials engineered for complex systems.

## Advanced Chemistry. Proven Reliability.

With a focus on molecular control and material performance, NOF AMERICA delivers specialty chemicals
that enable precision processing, stable formulations, and scalable production in highly technical
environments.

* Delivers top performance
* Designed for small pulleys

[ optibelt OPTIMAX HF2 ][186]

# High-performance drive belts from one of the world's leading manufacturers

[Divider]

Whether in mechanical engineering or the automotive sector, in medical technology, the food industry
or in household appliances - we develop industry-specific drive solutions for customers all over the
world and have become one of the world's leading manufacturers of high-performance drive belts.

#### Trade Fairs & Events 2026

This year, we will once again be represented at numerous trade fairs and events all over the world.
Take the opportunity to meet us in person, discover exciting new products and get in contact with
our experts.

[ Check all important dates ][187]

#### Easier planning, confident decisions

Our digital tools support you throughout your entire selection process - from technical design and
product selection to cost-benefit analysis. Our tools ease your daily work, speed up
decision-making, and increase the reliability of your planning.

[ Overview of all tools ][188]

#### Our commitment to sustainability

We take our social and environmental responsibility seriously as part of our global business
activities. With our mission "Optibelt Sustainability with Drive", we pursue a comprehensive
approach that takes equal account of economic, social and ecological aspects.

### Optibelt News

Press Release
29/04/2026

#### A new name. Proven technology. Even more possibilities.

The hallmark of our ATC system has always been its modular design – delivering maximum freedom of
design and exceptional adaptability to any application. Previously marketed as the ATC system, it is
now being relaunched under a new name: optibelt Modular Cleat System (MCS).

[ Read more ][201]
News
17/04/2026

#### Energy efficiency in industrial drive systems

Industrial drive systems are among the highest energy consumers in production environments. With
engines, gearboxes and belt drives often running continuously, they offer real potential for
significant energy savings through better technology. Modern high-performance belts are central to
achieving this. 

[ Read more ][202]
Press Release
23/01/2026

#### Arntz Optibelt Group donates 10,000 euros in support of organisations

The Arntz Optibelt Group demonstrates its ongoing social commitment to the region this year with its
support to the tune of 10,000 euros for four social and voluntary organisations. Each organisation
will receive 2,500 euros to foster the important work they do.

[ Read more ][203]

### Your Revenue Cycle, Running on Autopilot.

OSP's Agentic AI Revenue Engine automates the most repetitive task in your billing workflow —
calling payers to check claim status. It makes the calls, captures the updates, and reports
everything in real time, so your team spends zero time on hold.

#### What It Does:
* Automatically calls payers to check claim status
* Captures claim updates without any manual follow-up
* Logs and reports claim status directly to an Excel sheet
* Replaces hours of staff time spent on hold with payers

[ See It In Action ][113]
[RCM Revenue Engine Dashboard]
4x Faster Denial Resolution with AI
5x Reduction in Denial Management Workload

### Stop Writing Off Denied Claims. Start Recovering Them.

OSP's RCM Revenue Engine pulls denied claims from any source — EHR, clearinghouse, or manual upload
— uses AI to identify the root cause, determines the best course of action, and automates the entire
resolution workflow. From appeal letters to resubmissions to payer follow-up, it handles the work
your team never has time for.

#### What It Does
* Identifies root cause of every denial using AI
* Auto-generates appeal letters tailored to payer requirements
* Resubmits claims or routes complex cases to staff
* Tracks every denial from identification to resolution

[ See It In Action ][114]
[Claims Scrubbing Dashboard]
95%+ First-Pass Clean Claim Rate
50% Reduction in Manual Claim Review

### Every Claim Scrubbed Before It Leaves Your Office.

OSP's AI Claims Scrubbing Agent validates every claim before submission — checking coding accuracy,
payer rules, NCCI edits, and eligibility in real time. It catches the errors, suggests the fixes,
and routes clean claims to the payer, so your billing team never wastes time on preventable denials.

#### What It Does
* Automatically validates CPT, ICD-10, and HCPCS codes against payer-specific rules
* Catches coding errors, missing modifiers, and bundling violations before submission
* Verifies patient eligibility, prior auth, and COB in real time
* Routes clean claims to payer and flags dirty claims with specific fix instructions

### FDR

FDR technology is the only solution in the 3D printing market that enables production of fine detail
without sacrificing quality. 

[Discover More][86]

### Support Free

Smart Fusion is the latest advancement in metal additive manufacturing with real-time intelligent
heat management and the reduction of support structures.

[Discover More][87]

### Aluminium

Aluminum’s powerful material characteristics make it ideal for many applications in many industries,
for example aerospace and automotive. 

[Discover More][88]

### Copper

3D printing with copper now makes it possible to produce advanced applications from rocket
propulsion systems to copper coils.

[Discover More][89]

# Liquid Silicone Rubber Custom Component Solutions

SIMTEC specializes in high-quality liquid silicone rubber (LSR) and LSR multi-shot molded
components. For more than two decades, we have provided complete turnkey solutions for the global
leaders in the medical, healthcare, mobility, consumer, and industrial industries. We offer our
customers[ value-added custom solutions ][36]and comprehensive support from concept through
high-volume production. Our fully-automated advanced LSR injection molding technologies,
ISO-certified class 8 clean room, rigorous quality systems, and end-to-end project management ensure
we deliver consistent high quality parts that meet your exact specifications, optimizing your
product’s performance.

## SIMTEC's Full Portfolio of Services

SIMTEC is an environmentally responsible, US-based silicone molding company exclusively focused on
the production of customized injection molded [Liquid Silicone Rubber (LSR) parts][46], [LSR
overmolded parts][47], and [LSR 2-Shot (LSR/Thermoplastics) and Multi-Shot components][48]. Our team
of experts has decades of knowledge and experience injection molding LSR.  We provide greater value
to our partners by providing a full portfolio of services from early design and prototype support to
customized manufacturing processes and quality systems. We  provide custom solutions that address
the specific needs of each program and that deliver high-precision, high-volume, and high-quality
Liquid Silicone Rubber and LSR Multi-Shot molded components.

## Why Choose Liquid Silicone Rubber?

[Liquid Silicone Rubber][55] (LSR) is an ideal choice for a wide range of silicone molded parts.
Odorless, tasteless and hypoallergenic, it is the ideal raw material for devices used in a sterile
environment, have skin contact or contact with bodily fluids, or in food and beverage products. LSR
is also fatigue and tear resistant and features a low compression set, high elongation, and high
thermal stability. As a result, it can be used in extreme temperatures and deliver exceptional
durability, performance and repeatability. A variety of grades are available, including
[medical][56], [food contact][57], and high thermal conductivity grades

SIMTEC’s expertise in liquid silicone injection molding allows us to [manufacture liquid silicone
rubber parts][58] from simple to complex, in a wide variety of configurations, sizes, colors, and
part geometries. To discuss the details of an upcoming project, please [contact][59] us to speak
with a representative directly.

## SIMTEC Silicone Parts: LSR Injection Molding

Since 2002, SIMTEC Silicone Parts has been a valued partner to Fortune 100 companies and other
leading global businesses in the design and manufacturing of custom, high-quality Liquid Silicone
Rubber (LSR), LSR 2-Shot (LSR/Thermoplastics), and LSR Multi-Shot (LSR/Thermoplastic/Metal) parts.
SIMTEC serves an array of industries as a silicone products manufacturer, including but not limited
to [hygienic medical devices and healthcare products][60], [automotive components][61], [consumer
and baby products][62] and products used in [industrial applications.][63]

As one of the top custom silicone component manufacturing companies in North America, meeting the
needs of our customers in these and other industries has been our primary focus since the founding
of our company. When you work with us for an upcoming project, you are partnering with a team that
is committed to providing and maintaining the highest standards of quality and delivering
exceptional value.

SIMTEC specializes in high-quality liquid silicone rubber (LSR) and LSR multi-shot molded
components. For more than two decades, we have provided complete turnkey solutions for the global
leaders in the medical, healthcare, mobility, consumer, and industrial industries. We offer our
customers[ value-added custom solutions ][36]and comprehensive support from concept through
high-volume production. Our fully-automated advanced LSR injection molding technologies,
ISO-certified class 8 clean room, rigorous quality systems, and end-to-end project management ensure
we deliver consistent high quality parts that meet your exact specifications, optimizing your
product’s performance.

## SIMTEC's Full Portfolio of Services

SIMTEC is an environmentally responsible, US-based silicone molding company exclusively focused on
the production of customized injection molded [Liquid Silicone Rubber (LSR) parts][46], [LSR
overmolded parts][47], and [LSR 2-Shot (LSR/Thermoplastics) and Multi-Shot components][48]. Our team
of experts has decades of knowledge and experience injection molding LSR.  We provide greater value
to our partners by providing a full portfolio of services from early design and prototype support to
customized manufacturing processes and quality systems. We  provide custom solutions that address
the specific needs of each program and that deliver high-precision, high-volume, and high-quality
Liquid Silicone Rubber and LSR Multi-Shot molded components.

## Why Choose Liquid Silicone Rubber?

[Liquid Silicone Rubber][55] (LSR) is an ideal choice for a wide range of silicone molded parts.
Odorless, tasteless and hypoallergenic, it is the ideal raw material for devices used in a sterile
environment, have skin contact or contact with bodily fluids, or in food and beverage products. LSR
is also fatigue and tear resistant and features a low compression set, high elongation, and high
thermal stability. As a result, it can be used in extreme temperatures and deliver exceptional
durability, performance and repeatability. A variety of grades are available, including
[medical][56], [food contact][57], and high thermal conductivity grades

SIMTEC’s expertise in liquid silicone injection molding allows us to [manufacture liquid silicone
rubber parts][58] from simple to complex, in a wide variety of configurations, sizes, colors, and
part geometries. To discuss the details of an upcoming project, please [contact][59] us to speak
with a representative directly.

## SIMTEC Silicone Parts: LSR Injection Molding

Since 2002, SIMTEC Silicone Parts has been a valued partner to Fortune 100 companies and other
leading global businesses in the design and manufacturing of custom, high-quality Liquid Silicone
Rubber (LSR), LSR 2-Shot (LSR/Thermoplastics), and LSR Multi-Shot (LSR/Thermoplastic/Metal) parts.
SIMTEC serves an array of industries as a silicone products manufacturer, including but not limited
to [hygienic medical devices and healthcare products][60], [automotive components][61], [consumer
and baby products][62] and products used in [industrial applications.][63]

As one of the top custom silicone component manufacturing companies in North America, meeting the
needs of our customers in these and other industries has been our primary focus since the founding
of our company. When you work with us for an upcoming project, you are partnering with a team that
is committed to providing and maintaining the highest standards of quality and delivering
exceptional value.

## Precision molds powering the world’s leading plastic products.

With over 50 years of mold-making experience, we’re true experts in our craft. SyBridge builds molds
that perform and last—delivering solutions that meet your exacting requirements and keep your
program on-time and on-budget. 

[ Talk to an expert ][42] [ Learn more about us ][43]

## Your Full-Lifecycle Tooling Partner

From concept to high-volume production and ongoing maintenance, SyBridge supports your tooling needs
every step of the way. Our proven turnkey process combined with our custom approach ensures your
molds perform reliably and stand the test of time.

[ Explore Injection Mold Tooling ][44]

## Specialty Manufacturing Services

Our team provides services that help you move faster from concept to production. We operate one of
North America’s fastest-growing 3D printing production facilities, delivering high-quality, end-use
parts for leading companies across multiple sectors. We also offer quick-turn injection molding,
giving you production parts in weeks so you can dramatically accelerate your product development
cycle.

[ Let’s Talk ][50] [ Explore Parts Manufacturing ][51]

We partner with leading OEMs and contract manufacturers across key industries, delivering
high-performance tooling and manufacturing solutions that allow you to bring your products to
market, faster.

#### Power BI Consulting Services: What They Include and Why They Matter

Organizations across industries are investing heavily in business intelligence platforms to improve
decision-making, operational visibility, and data-driven strategy. Microsoft Power BI has emerged as

seamless integration with modern data platforms. However, deploying Power BI alone does not
automatically create a scalable analytics environment. Professional Power BI consulting services
help organizations move beyond basic reporting by designing structured analytics systems that
integrate data sources, automate reporting processes, and deliver reliable insights for business
leaders. The Role of Power BI in a Modern Analytics Environment Power BI acts as a bridge between
complex business data and actionable insights. When implemented effectively, it enables
organizations to consolidate data from multiple systems, standardize reporting, and deliver
real-time visibility into key performance indicators. Organizations often integrate data from ERP
systems, CRM platforms, finance tools, and operational databases into a centralized analytics
environment. With proper configuration, Power BI becomes a single interface where leadership teams
can track performance metrics, monitor operational trends, and evaluate strategic initiatives.

ongoing optimization, areas where consulting expertise becomes essential. What Happens During a

business objectives and existing data infrastructure. Consultants work closely with business
stakeholders to identify key performance indicators, reporting requirements, and data sources. This
discovery phase ensures that the analytics environment aligns with business priorities rather than
simply replicating existing reports. During this stage, consulting teams also evaluate data quality,
integration requirements, and governance policies that may affect implementation. Once the
